items.name: Danzig Oak Planking

items.name: London-pattern Chasers

items.name: Provencal Jib & Staysail

items.name: Gávea da Carreira

items.name: Tablazón de Galeón

items.note: The watertight bulkheads and layered planking of Zheng He's treasure ships, which sailed as far as Africa between 1405 and 1433.

items.name: Date Masamune Charts
items.note: The binnacle and Pacific charts of the galleon Date Masamune sent to Acapulco in 1613 with Hasekura Tsunenaga on board.

items.name: Dragon-head Cannon
items.note: The cannon fired through the dragon's mouth of Yi Sun-sin's turtle ship, which smashed Japanese hulls at close range in 1592.
